neighbours.label: Giving up rights or control to someone else: give up some rights, surrender, hand over, sign away, give away control; ordinary giving stays quiet
fire: Citizens must give up some freedoms for the state to work.
Many users unknowingly give away control of their photos.
By signing here, you surrender all rights to the land.
The tribe was forced to give up its lands.
The law forces towns to hand their schools over to the state.
Members agree to surrender their claims to the fund.
Nations give up part of their sovereignty to join.
He signed away the rights to his own songs.
quiet: Citizens must give some thought to how the state works.
Many users happily give feedback on their photos.
By signing here, you confirm your address on the form.
The tribe was forced to walk across its lands.
The law tells towns to paint their schools in spring.
Members agree to meet their friends at the fund dinner.
Nations send part of their teams to play.
He signed the back of his own photo.

notes: Card: ' to' x3, ' people', ' rights', ' giving', ' By', ' give', ' hand'. The + pole's logit effect suppresses ' surrender', ' relinqu', ' loses', ' voluntarily', so the - pole promotes them. Probe: 'give up some rights for' 0.65, 'hand ... over' 0.35, 'you grant' 0.26, 'give up something' 0.21, 'giving away control of' 0.15; 'give some money' 0.06, 'gave him a book' 0.00.
